name: Schöppingen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schöppingen (a white lamb on green).
history: Municipal flag of Schöppingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schöppingen arms — white lamb on green
